note:
Red Hood (SR/Iron — NOT `rapi-red-hood`, MG/Fire). Board: 0.970 COLD on 2 graded comps (0.93 / 1.01). Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/red-hood.test.ts, which pins every load-bearing line green vs shipped and red vs counterfactual.
Her Lambda burst is STAGE-CONDITIONAL and the three steps are encoded as three separate burstCast blocks. Step 1 (Beast Cage): allies casterAtkPct 77.55 / 10s, plus a self burstCdr 40 oncePerBattle. Step 2 (The Last Howl): a self burstCdr 40 oncePerBattle — the two refunds are read as two INDEPENDENT per-step once-per-battle grants, which is the prose-literal reading. Step 3 (Red Wolf): weaponSwap 51.46%/shot, chargeMultPct 250, 10s, chargeTimeSec 0.3, plus the S2 rider atkPct 71.42 / 10s, unlimitedAmmo 10s, and the charge-damage conversion below.
RED WOLF CADENCE is decoded game data (skill 1470610 + weapon 1047002), not an estimate: rate_of_fire 200rpm = exactly 1 shot per 18 frames (0.3s) REGARDLESS of charge speed. The step-3 Charge Speed ▲100.8% makes the charge instant, so the window is fire-rate-gated, not charge-gated — that is why the line appears as chargeTimeSec 0.3 rather than as a chargeSpeedPct buff, and why it is neither a block nor an unmodeled entry. ~33 shots per window; max_ammo 99 with the kit's infinite ammo, so no reload inside the window (ammo resets to max at swap expiry, which is the engine's swap behavior).
S1: 'Charge Speed ▲3.81%, stacks up to 10, 5 sec' on every normal attack = hitCount 1 chargeSpeedPct 3.81 / 5s / maxStacks 10. Its partner line — 'Convert excess over 100% Charge Speed to Charge Damage ▲240% of the excess' — is APPROXIMATED, not dropped: at 100.8 (swap) + 3.81 x 10 (stacks) = 138.9, the excess is 38.9 and the faithful value is (138.9 - 100) x 2.4 = 93.36. It ships as chargeDamagePct 90 ⚑, a stack-ramp AVERAGE, gated inside the stage-3 block. The mechanism is exact; only the ramp is averaged. Outside the burst her total Charge Speed is 38.1, below the 100 cap, so the faithful excess there is ZERO and the gating is correct. Do not fudge 90 to the warm 93.36 — the gap is the ramp, and closing it wants a measurement, not a rounder number. Recipe: full-charge popup read inside vs outside Red Wolf.
OUTSIDE Red Wolf she is an ordinary bolt-action SR and takes the engine's +22f bolt recovery (owner-confirmed). Her Pierce is a top-level hasPierce, so partner Pierce Damage buffs (e.g. mint's 32.72) land on her.
UNMODELED / inert: Beast Cage's DEF ▲50.68% of caster DEF (defensive, no HP pool); The Last Howl's 'Recovers 23.04% of attack damage as HP' — SELF-scoped, so it cannot reach an ally-side on-recovery consumer even if emitted, making the missing emit a consistency item and not a fit one; Step 2's taunt and Incoming healing ▲74.88% (the boss never acts, no HP pool); Step 3's 'Expand Pierce range by 100%' (no range primitive, and the boss is partless).
SWAP CADENCE: her swap sets no `weapon` and she carries no measured unit-level pullsPerSec, and her window is charge-time-gated anyway, so the 'a swap shadows a unit's measured cadence' engine gap does not reach her.

■ Activates during The Last Howl. Affects self. Recovers 23.04% of attack damage as HP over 10 sec.

caveats: skill1: the continuous excess-Charge-Speed → Charge-Damage conversion (Charge Damage ▲240% of the excess over the +100% cap) is APPROXIMATED, not dropped — it ships as the static stage-3-gated chargeDamagePct 90 ⚑, a stack-ramp average against a warm value of 93.36 = (138.9 - 100) x 2.4. Out of burst her total Charge Speed of 38.1 sits below the cap, so the faithful excess there is zero and the stage-3 gate is right. Pending a full-charge popup read inside vs outside Red Wolf.

skill2: 'Recovers 23.04% of attack damage as HP' is recorded, not emitted as a recovery event. Her lifesteal is SELF-scoped, so it could never reach an ally-side on-recovery consumer (a heal fires recovery only at its own block's targets) — this is a roster-wide consistency question across the 5 non-emitting lifesteal carriers, wanting one ruling, not a unit-local fix.
